# package ocpptest

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/ocpptest"
```

Package ocpptest helps applications test their OCPP handlers against a real go-ocpp peer over a WebSocket on the loopback interface, the way net/http/httptest helps test HTTP handlers.

A CSMS application tests its handlers with a station from Station; a station application tests its handlers with a CSMS from CSMS. Recorder is a dispatcher that records what arrives and answers from a table, for the side the test does not implement:

	rec := ocpptest.NewRecorder()
	rec.Answer("BootNotification", `{"status":"Accepted","currentTime":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","interval":300}`)
	srv, url := ocpptest.CSMS(t, server.WithHandler(ocpp.V201, rec))
	c := ocpptest.Station(t, url+"CS1", client.WithHandler(ocpp.V201, myStationHandler))
	... // drive the station application
	req := rec.Wait(t, "BootNotification")

Everything started is stopped when the test ends.

## Constants

```go
const Timeout = 10 * time.Second
```

Timeout bounds the waits of this package.

## Functions

### func CSMS

```go
func CSMS(t testing.TB, opts ...server.Option) (*server.Server, string)
```

CSMS starts a go-ocpp server with opts on the loopback interface and returns it with the base URL stations connect to ("ws://127.0.0.1:port/ ocpp/"; append the station identity). Without an authentication option it adds server.WithoutAuthentication. The server is shut down when the test ends.

### func Session

```go
func Session(t testing.TB, srv *server.Server, id string) *server.Session
```

Session waits until srv has a session for the station id and returns it.

### func Station

```go
func Station(t testing.TB, url string, opts ...client.Option) *client.Client
```

Station creates a go-ocpp client for url with opts, plus client.WithInsecureTransport (the test server is plain ws on loopback), connects it, and closes it when the test ends.

## Types

### type Recorder

```go
type Recorder struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Recorder is an ocpp.Dispatcher and ocpp.SendDispatcher that records every CALL and SEND it receives and answers CALLs from a table. An action without an answer gets the CALLERROR NotImplemented. It does not validate payloads: put a version package's dispatcher in front of it (or use ValidateRequest) when validation matters. Safe for concurrent use.
